input.baseline: Twice a week, about 5 km each. My easy 5 km takes 35–37 minutes. Longest run was 7 km.

asked.question: Do you have a finish time in mind?
Why does it matter?
asked.answer: To finish it with my friends

baselineMeasurements.sourceQuote: Twice a week, about 5 km each.
Twice a week, about 5 km each.

options.rationale: A patient build from 10 km a week with easy running and a gradual long run, so you can finish the half marathon with your friends.
assumptions: Finishing is the goal, with no time target
You stay healthy and can train 3 days a week
Easy pace stays around 7:00 to 7:24 per km
Long run grows gradually toward race distance

options.rationale: Four runs a week with gradual growth of about 10% a week from 12 km, building the long run toward half marathon distance in a shorter time than the steady road.

Four to five days a week are available
No pain or illness interrupts training
Goal is to finish with friends, no time target

input.baseline: 60 kg for 5 reps, 3 sets. I lift 3 days a week, with a rack and a spotter.

baselineMeasurements.sourceQuote: 60 kg for 5 reps, 3 sets. I lift 3 days a week

options.rationale: A patient climb of about 20 kg over 24 weeks, adding small loads every few weeks from your current 60 kg for 5, keeping your 3 days and sessions of 15 reps.
assumptions: You keep benching 3 days a week with the rack and spotter
Load rises about 2.5 kg every 3 to 4 weeks
Sleep, food and recovery stay steady
A stalled week is repeated, not forced

phases.title: Consolidate 60 kg
phases.progressCheck: All 3x5 at 60 kg done cleanly, first 62.5 kg top set completed by week 4

phases.title: Build to 65 kg
phases.progressCheck: Top set of 5 reps at 65 kg with the spotter only touching nothing

phases.title: Build to 70 kg
phases.progressCheck: Top set of 5 reps at 70 kg, bar speed steady on the last rep

phases.title: Build to 77.5 kg
phases.progressCheck: Top set of 5 reps at 75 kg, then one at 77.5 kg

phases.title: Test week
phases.progressCheck: One top set of 80 kg for 5 reps, logged with the spotter present

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with a few lighter sets, then 3 working sets of 5 at 60 kg. Rest about 2.5 minutes between sets. Use the rack and your spotter. Keep the same form on every rep.

targets.effort: Moderate to hard, 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps completed per set and how the last rep felt

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 light at 55 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter technique day. Warm up, then 3 sets of 5 at 55 kg with a smooth controlled lowering and a steady press. Rest about 2 minutes between sets. Use the rack and spotter.

targets.progressMeasure: Note bar control and whether all reps felt easy

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up, then 3 working sets of 5 at 60 kg. Rest about 2.5 minutes between sets. Try to make every rep as crisp as on Monday. Spotter ready on all sets.

targets.effort: Moderate to hard, 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Compare the effort of the last set with Monday

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up, then 3 working sets of 5 at 60 kg with about 2.5 minutes of rest. Aim for the same clean reps with a little less effort than last week.

targets.effort: Moderate to hard, 1-2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log whether all 15 reps felt easier than week 1

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 light at 55 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter day. Warm up, then 3 sets of 5 at 55 kg with a pause of one second on the chest on each rep. Rest about 2 minutes. Use the rack and spotter.

targets.progressMeasure: Note how steady the press feels after each pause

sessions.title: Bench top set 62.5 kg then 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up, then one set of 5 at 62.5 kg, then 2 sets of 5 at 60 kg. Rest about 2.5 to 3 minutes between sets. Spotter ready. If the 62.5 kg set is slow, stay at 60 kg next week.

targets.effort: Hard on the first set, 1 rep left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log whether the 62.5 kg set of 5 was completed cleanly

options.rationale: Four days a week with steady load rises of about 1 kg a week from 60 kg. It asks for more frequent bench work than a patient road would, without big jumps.
assumptions: Bench is trained on all 3 current lifting days
Rack and spotter available every session
Loads move up only when all reps are clean

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Warm up with lighter sets, then do 3 sets of 5 at 60 kg in the rack with your spotter. Keep a steady tempo and stop if form breaks down.

targets.effort: Moderately hard, 2 reps left in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log whether all 15 reps were clean and how hard the last set felt

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 52.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter day. Do 3 sets of 5 at 52.5 kg with a controlled lowering and a brief pause on the chest. Focus on bar path and a steady pace.

targets.effort: Easy to moderate, 3 or more reps in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Note bar speed and whether form stayed the same on every rep

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 60 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Repeat 3 sets of 5 at 60 kg with the spotter. Try to make the last set as smooth as the first.

targets.effort: Moderately hard, 1 to 2 reps in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps completed per set and the effort of the last set

sessions.title: Light technique bench 3x3
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Short easy session. Do 3 sets of 3 at 50 kg, with a pause on the chest and a smooth press. This should leave you fresh for the week ahead.

targets.progressMeasure: Note how fresh the shoulders and chest feel afterwards

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 62.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: First small step up. Warm up well, then do 3 sets of 5 at 62.5 kg in the rack with your spotter. Reduce next time if the last reps slow a lot.

targets.effort: Moderately hard, 1 to 2 reps in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log whether all 15 reps were completed at 62.5 kg

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 55 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Lighter day. Do 3 sets of 5 at 55 kg with a controlled tempo and a pause on the chest. Keep your setup the same every set.

targets.effort: Easy to moderate, 3 reps in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Note bar speed and form consistency across all sets

sessions.title: Bench 3x5 at 62.5 kg
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Repeat 3 sets of 5 at 62.5 kg with the spotter. Aim for clean, even reps and use the full rest between sets.

targets.effort: Hard but controlled, 1 rep in reserve
targets.progressMeasure: Log reps per set and whether the third set slowed down

sessions.title: Light technique bench 3x3
sessions.descriptiveGuide: Short easy session. Do 3 sets of 3 at 52.5 kg with a smooth, controlled press. Stop each set well before any slowing.

targets.progressMeasure: Note recovery and how ready you feel for week 3
